name: Kublai Khan
source:
"What is it, my kitten? What do you need? ...Or is it that... you can't forget last night?"

Based on Kublai Khan, who was the fifth Khagan (Great Khan) of the Ikh Mongol Uls (Mongol Empire), reigning from 1260 to 1294, and the founder of the Yuan dynasty in Mongolia and China, a division of the Mongol Empire.

The Mongolian governor, who travels by horseback across the grassland. Because of her handsome, gallant-featured face and showy words and actions, she attracts every woman in the country. She seeks to become a great hero like grandmother Genghis Khan, who was a legendary leader of Mongolia.

[From [url=http://fruitbatfactory.com/eiyuusenki/char.html#char04a]English official site[/url]]
